title: Opinions on modern music, rock and bebop
summary: Albert complains that today's musicians play noise, citing rock and bebop against his definition of music.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Then too, I mean, just the short time that you have tonight, why there are so many other musicians that I would like to recognize that I know have been exceptionally good artists. Today, the trend that you have today, the musicians don't play music. They play noise.
Yeah, some of that rock and roll as well as the pop, I think too.

That's right. Even this running over the horn, the bebop or whatever they call it, there's no feeling there. And the first thing that I learned when I studied music was that music was the combination of sounds that was pleasing to the ear. Now when it deviates from there,
